auditoria.erro: maturity: "stable" is not stated by the page; it only says open source and lists features. Should be "unknown". serve none is right.

final.role: Pipeline de processamento de dados para logs (ingest, transform, ship)
final.evidence: Logstash is an open source server-side data processing pipeline that ingests data from a multitude of sources, transforms it, and then sends it to your favorite "stash."

auditoria.nota: Heavy server-side log ingestion pipeline; overkill and off-target for indexing a Markdown notes hub.
